what_is_vps.question: What is VPS/VDS hosting?
what_is_vps.answer: VPS (Virtual Private Server) or VDS (Virtual Dedicated Server) is a service that provides users with a virtual dedicated server. You get full control over the system (root access) and can install any software.

difference.question: What makes your VPS hosting different from others?
difference.answer: We use only modern hardware with fast NVMe SSD drives, provide unlimited traffic, and offer reliable DDoS protection on all plans. Our goal is to offer maximum performance at an affordable price.

change_plan.question: Can I change the plan in the future?
change_plan.answer: Yes, you can easily scale your server resources at any time. Upgrading to a more powerful plan is quick with minimal downtime.

operating_system.question: What operating system can I install?
operating_system.answer: We offer popular Linux distributions such as Ubuntu, Debian, and CentOS. You can choose the desired OS when ordering the server.
